notes.title: Development Plans
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We are currently actively working on Early Access and want to share with players our plans for the Demo and Early Access.
[b]Demo[/b]
Before the Early Access release, we want to make several patches in which we will fix bugs and slightly change the gameplay.
As soon as the game is released in Early Access, we will change the demo and add new mechanics to it.
[b]Early Access Release[/b]
A short list of what we will add to Early Access:
[list]
[*] Release 4 space locations + internal locations
[*] New anomalies
[*] Add a player base - a separate location
[*] Add vehicle - Reaper
[*] Add character needs - food and water
[*] Add character progression
[*] Add equipment upgrades
[*] Add a story
[*] Add a map
[/list]
All of the above is already partially implemented in the prototype, but we need to test it all, polish it + fix as many bugs as possible.
[b]Timeline[/b]
We plan to release EA (Early Access) this year. Follow the updates to find out the exact release date!
